issues.symptom: Score/judge stage of the incremental ingest+score pipeline never consumed the persisted MinIO metas after ingestion succeeded; harness silently defaulted every unscored doc to verdict=ERROR with node_count/chars=null, even though live MinIO metas show real PASS/MARGINAL verdicts for 23/24 docs. This is a process-integrity bug, not a tree-quality regression: a scoring stage must fail loudly, not fabricate ERROR rows.
issues.start_tracing_from: the score-stage entry point of the incremental ingest+score pipeline (per memory 'incremental-ingest-score-pipeline.md') and the arq job handler that hands off from ingestion completion to scoring/judge invocation
